properties.type: enumeration, one-of: text, image, circle, rect, square, video
properties.text: text to render (if type supports this)
properties.x: horizontal position on the canvas. Absolute in px or relative, e.g. 10%
properties.contour: color used for drawing the contour of a shape (if type supports this)
properties.textTransform: transformation will be applied for rendering text (if type supports this). Mostly CSS properties with some additions
properties.radius: radius used for drawing a shape (if type supports this)
properties.gradient: gradient color for drawing a shape (if type supports this)
properties.width: horizontal size of shape (if type supports this)
properties.height: vertical size of shape (if type supports this)
properties.fps: frames per second of a video object
